unit: one frozen greedy Top-1 generation per adapter/query
failure_policy: Missing extraction, empty candidate, parse error, compile failure, simulation failure, or timeout remains in the denominator and scores false.
strict_success: compile_ok and correct_pass and buggy_fail and antecedent_hit and non_vacuous and heldout_correct_pass and heldout_buggy_fail and heldout_antecedent_hit and heldout_non_vacuous

metrics.Family Recall: number of bug families with at least one strict_success query divided by the number of test bug families
metrics.TOR: trace_overfit count divided by primary_success count; zero-denominator is reported as null

reported_splits.project_ood: N/A: Pilot training covers all three frozen projects

prohibited: dropping failed extractions or failed compilations
